reviews.text:
I was recommended to Dr.  Richard Smollin by my dogwalker in 2005.  He has treated 4 of my dogs over the years and currently treats my dog, Rocco.  Dr. Smollin is an amazing Veterinarian and his staff, Susie and Arie are always wonderful.  Thank you Dr. Smollin for taking care of my animals all these years.
Thang

After diagnosing my dog with one thing, I returned to the office, and they attempted to tell me they were wrong and it would cost me more money for something other medication.  I took my dog to another vet and they diagnosed it with something totally different.  Upon my dog being mis-diagnosed, I called the office and attempted to explain to them my concerns, and the staff hung up the phone.  Really?  I just wanted to explain to them my concerns and confusion and they hung up the phone on me.  Unbelievable.  I would give them 0 star if I could.
We love Dr. Smollin. He is knowledgeable based on his years of experience and very fair with recommendations and treatment options.

I brought my 12-year-old Chihuahua here for a dental procedure. The Dr. and the staff, were wonderful, transparent, and treated my senior dog with care and patience, from the moment we walked in.

Their prices were very reasonable.  (They prioritized my dog’s comfort over making a quick buck compared to other Vets)

After the procedure, my dog came home perfectly fine.  He is now much more comfortable and happy.  If you are looking for a vet who provides quality care without overcharging, this is the place!

This place is great. We have been bringing out pets here for many years, and even when we have strays that need help, these guys are amazing. The staff are so friendly, and loving. The doctors are the same. The prices are super reasonable, and the service is amazing. They always answer the phone. Since covid it has changed a little. You need an appointment, you pull into the parking lot, you call them from your car, and they come out to help you. If you are looking for a forever Vet, look no more. We are so happy with Winnetka Animal Clinic.

Wonderful care and kindness – highly recommended

We visited Winnetka Animal Clinic on December 22, 2025 because our dog was vomiting and had diarrhea. We were very worried, but from the moment we arrived, the staff made us feel calm and supported.

The veterinarian and the entire team were incredibly kind, patient, and thorough. They took the time to carefully examine our dog, explain everything clearly, and treat him with genuine compassion. You could truly feel that they care about animals, not just doing their job.

Thanks to their professional and loving care, our dog recovered well, and we left with great peace of mind. We are very grateful for how well they treated both our dog and us.

Highly recommend Winnetka Animal Clinic to anyone looking for a trustworthy and caring veterinary clinic.
Took our sweet girl to get her arthritis shot! She's going to be feeling better soon.
This is the place to trust your pets with. Dr. Smollen is amazing, and the staff is lovely! Also, prices are reasonable which in the vet world is a rarity on our with winning the lotto.
Great, pet caring people.  Been going there for over thirty years.
Best vet clinic we've ever been to. The staff are all wonderful and the doctor is amazing
Love you guys Thank you for taking such good care of our Bonnie!

I was just at winnetka veterinarian i had the best experience as I do always and I had to write something down. They are most honest and professional staff that you can find at any veterinarian, one of the nurses called Nicole. She has helped me so much and so nice that I never had that experience anywhere else. So if you all looking to find a knowledgeable and honest veterinarian, go to Winnetka  veterinarian.

I brought in my 4 month old kitten Choko to this animal clinic for a leg injury as soon as they opened at 8 am. The staff told me they were appointments only, so I got nervous for a second, but they told me to drop her off, and Dr. Sharrif would call me later before they closed.  I thought that was very nice of them. The Dr called me around 1230p. I went back at 230p for pick up and was advised of the diagnosis plus the info for my Choko's medications. The price was fair, the staff was friendly, and my overall experience was very good.  I believe that everyone there really cares for animals, and I  will definitely return. I recommend this place.

I brought my dog in for a checkup and some vaccinations, and I had a good experience. The staff was kind and caring, and even though our appointment started about 30 minutes late, it was still a great visit overall.

For first-time appointments, they do require a $50 deposit, which is taken over the phone via credit card and goes toward the cost of the first visit.
I’ve gone to Winnetka Animal Clinic for years because I know Dr. Smollins and his staff show you how much they care about your pets!

I had the best experience yesterday as a new client. Mark, at the front, greeted me and i let him know that my dog is a bit reactive to other dogs, and he made sure no one else was in the clinic before he brought us in. Then Nicole, our vet tech, was AMAZING! So sweet, patient and helpful! She gave me great suggestions to support my dog as well as answered the MANY questions I had. Finally, the doc himself, Dr. Warren, was phenomenal. He examined my dog with gentleness and patience and they were not pushy about medications, tests or anything unnecessary. Thank you all for a wonderful vet experience!
I love these guys. Doing their best during these tough times takes energy and dedication, which they have in spades. I'll always take my pets here.
Friendl

I WILL BE BACK! It was a weekend and our senior dog was sick. The clinic (and every other I tried) had no openings or walk-ins available. The tech was willing take my dogs temperature which gave me incredible piece of mind that he didn’t have a raging infection. She took the time to offer other advice as well. She truly cared about my pet!! Due to her kindness I will make this our new vet. Like forever. 🐶🥰
Dr Smollen is great! Always compassionate and has so many years of experience.

I've been bringing my dog for over a year. The first year visits were fast. This was important since they make you wait.in your car and we know how fussy animals can get. The last few visits we've had to wait over 20 minutes just to be …
Terrific Doctor and staff at very reasonable cost! Thank you Winnetka Animal Clinic!

Excellent place, very friendly and attentive, I highly recommend it. I took my dog ​​because I need a certificate to travel and they were very kind and gave me the address of the place to complete the process.
